subject: Discovery recap + reserve window for dedicated capacity sizing
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@brightrail.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom@brightrail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + reserve window for dedicated capacity sizing

Alicia / Tom — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from our side and a proposed next step.

Recap (top-line):
- Primary workload: real-time ticket routing and short text summarization for customer incidents.
- Expected steady-state: ~1k qps across batch / live paths; peak bursts up to ~3k qps for 30–90s during morning commute windows.
- Typical payloads: 128–512 token requests (median ~220 tokens); a small subset are long chat sessions (~1.5k tokens).
- SLO targets: p95 generation latency <150ms for short requests; tail latency tolerance for long sessions.
- Compliance note: data residency must remain in us-west for production.

Proposed next step: dedicated capacity sizing call — 60–90 minute technical deep dive (we'll bring serving, runtime, and ops). Agenda:
1) Walk your precise QPS and sequence length distribution (we'll use your load profile)
2) Map to GPU footprint (concurrency, batching, KV cache strategy)
3) Identify test plan and runbook for a validation window
4) Action items and resource ownership (mutual action plan)

Two windows that work on our side — please confirm which one suits BrightRail or suggest alternatives:
- Tue, Jun 14 — 10:00–11:30 AM PT
- Wed, Jun 15 — 01:00–02:30 PM PT

I've attached a short template for the load profile (brightrail-load-profile.csv). If you can fill that out ahead of the call (or share your telemetry/snapshot), it will speed the sizing discussion.

Attachment: brightrail-load-profile.csv (CSV, 9 KB)

If Jun 15 works, we can invite our SRE (Ben) and runtime lead (Sergio) and circulate a mutual-action-plan doc before the call.

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0147
